headline: Longer and more frequent marine heatwaves — independently confirmed
framing: A signed replication of Oliver et al. (2018). Using independent satellite sea-surface temperature (ESA CCI) and independent detection software (XMHW), the satellite-era rise in marine-heatwave days is Validated — and robust to El Nino. The century-scale "54%" figure is deliberately out of scope. Retold below for citizens and for schools.

hero.caption: Global-mean marine-heatwave days, 1982-2016, from independent ESA CCI SST and XMHW — reproducing Oliver et al. (2018) Figure 2. The rising trend survives ENSO removal.
